edge_meanings.has_domain: the standard is organised into this domain
edge_meanings.has_requirement: the control is met through this numbered requirement
edge_meanings.expects_evidence_in: the requirement is evidenced by artefacts of this category
edge_meanings.typically_found_in: the evidence for this requirement typically lives here
edge_meanings.applies_to_capability: the item applies to systems with this capability
edge_meanings.tagged: the control carries this published keyword
edge_meanings.maps_to: AIUC publishes a crosswalk from this control to that clause
edge_meanings.in_framework: the crosswalked clause belongs to this external framework
edge_meanings.derived_from: this release was built from this repository commit
edge_meanings.evidenced_by: this record was read from this captured source observation
edge_meanings.affects: this change event is about this control
edge_meanings.in_release: this change event belongs to this release
edge_meanings.names: this official changelog row names this control
edge_meanings.superseded_by: this control was merged into that control
